code_fixes_in_this_reissue.source: AUDIT-FINDINGS-20260729-B.md §B2 and AUDIT-FINDINGS-20260728.md §B2 ('The Gate-4 CLI validator evaluates none of its four physics checks, self-compares four of its six freeze checks, and returns PASS on pure noise'). Reproduced by three independent audit dimensions; verdict 'reproduced'.
what_was_wrong: main() called build_gate4_report without marginal=, normalization=, saturation_frac= or closure=, and the builder SKIPPED every component whose argument was None -- so four physics checks never executed.

frozen_observed was built by copying FROZEN['edges_pt'], FROZEN['edges_pparallel'], FROZEN['bin_order'] and FROZEN['seed_policy'] into the 'observed' dict, so four of the six freeze checks compared FROZEN to FROZEN.
frozen_observed carried no central_vector and no reported_bin_mask, so those three freeze checks never ran either; the reporting mask was untouched by the gate.

The driver persisted no niter/epochs/seeds/train_events/input-sha, so freeze:seed_policy was unfalsifiable by construction: a nominal launched with --niter 1 --epochs 2 validated PASS against a receipt recording niter 2 / epochs 8.

z['target'] -- the sole carrier of refinement_is_learned_production, refined_sum, pot_scale and signed_target_hash -- was never read, although the driver writes it. A grep for target/refinement over the validator returned zero hits.
check_weights_finite_coverage was called with n_expected = len(imc), i.e. coverage was only ever compared against the subsample's own length, so train_events 2,000,000 -> 1000 was caught by nothing.

Net effect, reproduced by the audit: 15 checks, 0 failed, verdict PASS on an npz whose weights_push was |N(1,0.3)| random noise -- while the emitted receipt embedded frozen_contract.tolerances, so a reader concluded they were met.
structural_rules_now_enforced: ABSENT EVIDENCE FAILS. build_gate4_report emits a named failing '<component>:evidence_supplied' check instead of dropping the component. A gate is allowed to fail; it is not allowed to abstain and call that a pass.
EVERYTHING COMPARED AGAINST FROZEN IS READ FROM THE ARTIFACT (or recomputed from the G2 dump). A self-comparison is not a check.

checks_that_now_execute.closure:ordinary_pass / closure:stress_r: from the two new required CLI arguments --closure-report and --stress-report. Both closure scripts gained a --json report in this patch; neither had any machine-readable output, which is why these three checks had nothing to read.
checks_that_now_execute.closure:ordinary_is_negweight_refined /: RESTORE-2026-08-03.md Step 3 refuses the purity control and the 2026-07-26 Delta synthetic-fixture run (job 20489224) as closure evidence in prose. These refuse them in code, and additionally refuse a closure re-run whose own --l1-max / --push-med-tol were loosened, or that histogrammed on a non-frozen grid. push_median_dev_max = 0.15 (that script's --push-med-tol) is live for the first time.
checks_that_now_execute.cap:saturation_frac: the logit-cap saturation fraction, recomputed by the validator from weights_push itself as |log(push)| >= REWEIGHT_LOGIT_CAP. Previously cap_saturation_frac_max = 1e-3 was a tolerance no check used.
checks_that_now_execute.freeze:central_vector_len / _finite / _n: the driver now persists a unit-normalized 285-cell pushed reporting spectrum and the prior-occupied mask; the validator recomputes both from the dump and requires agreement (spectra:driver_validator_*), so the length/order checks read the artifact and are falsifiable rather than 285-long by construction.

checks_that_now_execute.target:mode_is_negweight_refined / refin: the measured-target provenance block. The load-bearing one is refinement_is_learned_production: per Step 4, Delta has no ROOT, so u2d.refine_stay_positive cannot import there and a Delta run can only inject an sklearn refinement, which self-reports False. Nothing previously stopped such a result being validated as the publication nominal.

It had no caller of its own, main() deliberately never wired it, and its target is acceptance-dependent (over the full truth population a correct unfold gives 1 + <a>(R-1) ~ 1.08, not 1), so it could never be the gate. this_reissue.honest_limit: NO SECOND REVIEWER. The 07-21 issue claimed an independent agy red-team pass; this re-issue has no independent agent verification of any kind. What replaces it is adversarial coverage inside the suite -- every assertion that something PASSES is paired with a mutation that must FAIL, and the four mutations the §4 audit found uncaught are now covered -- but that is the same actor's tests, not an independent read. Treat the code fixes as unreviewed by a second party.

The PET network itself could not even be constructed on this host (see open_blockers.stress_closure_run_not_recorded), so no full-event training path was exercised end to end.
